title: One Graph and Thirty Years
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：conclusion　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conclusion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 my uncle ① drew a conclusion from a graph nobody else had read, and he said the drawing was the whole of the study. The ② conclusion, meaning the finding and not the number, ran to eleven words and stayed that length; conclusion, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how little it is checked.

Every ③ conclusion in that report had the same table under it, and the ④ conclusion at the end, meaning the one he kept for the meeting and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever quoted twice. Conclusion, my aunt said, is nine parts table and one part somebody willing to check; my uncle said the checking is the part that fills the appendix.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the conclusion was the whole of the letter, meaning the ending and not the finding. The ⑥ conclusion, meaning the ending and not any of that, is the only thing in a letter that everybody remembers and nobody quotes; conclusion, she said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a finding and an ending. He said the ending is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ conclusion had become a line in a summary, and the summary had become an argument about the table. The ⑧ conclusion of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in August, was one graph and thirty years of checking; conclusion, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to check. She said the checking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ conclusion I remember is the one at the end, which he drew in 1985 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ conclusion, my aunt said in 1987, is the only thing that improves by being quoted; every conclusion, she said, is an ending that has agreed to look like a finding. She said the ending was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 结论（指那个推论本身，与那些数字相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a conclusion 得出结论
D. n. 结论（指那份报告里每一条）
E. n. 结论（指末尾那一条）
F. n. 结尾；结束部分（指信的结尾）
G. n. 结论（指摘要里提到的那一条）
H. n. 定论；论断（抽象总称）

items.q: drew a conclusion from a graph nobody else had read
The conclusion, meaning the finding and not the number
the conclusion was the whole of the letter
the conclusion had become a line in a summary
The conclusion of the whole thing
A conclusion, my aunt said in 1987

answers.why: draw a conclusion 意为“得出结论”，1971 年叔叔从一张别人都没读过的图表里得出了一个结论。
conclusion 意为“结论”，指那个推论本身而不是那些数字，它只有十一个词。
conclusion 指那份报告里每一条结论，每一条下面都垫着同一张表。
conclusion 指末尾那一条（他留给会议的那一条），是唯一有人引用过两次的。
conclusion 意为“结尾、结束部分”，母亲说结尾就是那封信的全部，指的是结束语而不是那个推论。
conclusion 为另一个义项，指信的结尾而不是那个推论，是信里人人都记得、却无人引用的东西。
conclusion 意为“结论”，指摘要里提到的那一条，到 1979 年这条结论成了摘要里的一行。
conclusion 意为“定论、论断”，叔叔八月写道，整件事的论断是一张图表三十年的核对。
conclusion 意为“结论”，我记得的是末尾那一条，他 1985 年得出，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
conclusion 为抽象总称，姑姑说一条结论是唯一会因为被引用而变好的东西。
